definitions.explanation: The highest rank or leading position in a competition, ranking, or standings. Common in sports, business, and academic contexts.

examples.japanese: わがチームは{開幕|かいまく}から{首位|しゅい}を{守|まも}っている。
examples.english: Our team has held first place since the start of the season.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}ランキングで{首位|しゅい}の{座|ざ}を{獲得|かくとく}したが、{来月|らいげつ}も{維持|いじ}できるかは{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: We captured the top spot in the sales ranking, but it's unclear whether we can maintain it next month.

notes:
Commonly used in sports standings and business rankings. Literally "head position" — {首|しゅ} (head/chief) + {位|い} (rank/position).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首位|しゅい}に{立|た}つ (to take the lead)
- {首位|しゅい}を{守|まも}る (to defend/hold first place)
- {首位|しゅい}を{走|はし}る (to lead the pack)
- {首位|しゅい}の{座|ざ} (the top position)
- {首位|しゅい}{争|あらそ}い (race for first place)
- {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ} (batting leader — baseball)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一位|いちい} simply means "number one / first rank"
- {首位|しゅい} emphasizes leading a competition or standing at the top
